description: Defines the SecretKeyWrapper class, which manages wrapping and unwrapping SecretKey instances using an RSA key pair stored in Android's KeyStore. It handles key generation, retrieval, and cryptographic operations related to key wrapping.

classes.name: SecretKeyWrapper
classes.description: A utility class that manages wrapping and unwrapping SecretKey instances with an RSA key pair stored in Android's KeyStore, facilitating secure key storage and cryptography.

methods.name: SecretKeyWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper, loading or generating an RSA key pair in the AndroidKeyStore based on an alias.

methods.name: generateKeyPair
methods.description: Generates an RSA key pair in the AndroidKeyStore with the specified alias.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Wraps a given SecretKey using the public key stored in the key pair.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps a previously wrapped SecretKey blob using the private key stored in the key pair.
